title: How to Add a Logo Watermark to Video with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use one natural-language request to let Claude inspect your media, call Medux through MCP, upload the assets, position the logo, and return a finished MP4.
operation: Use one natural-language request to let Claude inspect your media, call Medux through MCP, upload the assets, position the logo, and return a finished MP4.
prompt: Prompt used in Claude Use Medux to add logo.png to sample.mp4. Resize the logo to an appropriate size and place it in the top-right corner of the video. Upload the files using the curl command.
